t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Try to note the gnome that give more points and play it for a while after which the winning gnome might change.

vb_textbox.text: Try to figure out which of the colour gnomes give the higher score and stick to it for a while. After a while, it will change so you switch to the other colour gnome. Try to follow this pattern intermittently and bet on 5x, Good luck.
